claim_level: C2 exact finite theorem; physical SU(2) instantiation open

nodes.statement: The input is a finite nonnegative sub-Markov kernel and a nonempty seed partition.
One signature step refines, and never coarsens, the current partition.
Starting with b cells on n states, strict refinement terminates after at most n-b rounds.
The terminal partition is stable: rows in each cell have identical exact mass into every terminal cell.
Every stable refinement of the seed refines every algorithmic iterate, hence refines the terminal partition.
The terminal partition is the unique coarsest stable refinement of the seed, up to relabeling.
Each strict split has an exact target-cell mass witness, and refinement is equivariant under state permutations.
The Stage 18 moment-only law remains a counterexample: an indiscrete stable partition cannot recover an absent history observable.
The Stage 19 two-state rationalized fixture satisfies QV=qV exactly when the displayed decimal q=0.002430277501841998 is parsed as a rational.
Unequal channel persistence splits the Stage 24 four-channel defect cell while equal channels retain their symmetry quotient.
A normalized finite retained-boundary kernel for nonlinear SU(2) Yang-Mills has been constructed.
The physical stable partition has cutoff- and volume-uniform size and a uniform weighted defect ceiling.
The resulting physical kernel implies continuum Yang-Mills existence and a mass gap.
